judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A soft, hazy sky with a faint hint of iridescence, pleasant but too diffuse and low-contrast to be memorable.
strengths: soft layered cloud bands give some depth
subtle iridescent glow near the bright sun spot
gentle vertical gradient from bright to blue-gray
weaknesses: no distinct cloud shapes or focal structure
